svg.title: Recover every component of the detector
svg.desc: The classifier file alone cannot reproduce a detector that also depends on preprocessing and a normal reference bank. Match nearest-patch, fitting count, and C to this returned classifier. These metrics use validation boards.
svg.text: Recover every component of the detector
What must be loaded to reproduce a board’s decision?
Match nearest-patch, fitting count, and C to this returned classifier. These metrics use validation boards.
